Okay, so I need to figure out who was born first between Arthur Conan Doyle and Penelope Lively. I remember that Arthur Conan Doyle is the guy who created Sherlock Holmes, and Penelope Lively is a British author too. I think I've heard that Penelope Lively was born earlier, but I'm not entirely sure. Let me try to work this out step by step.

First, I should probably look up their birth dates. I know that Arthur Conan Doyle was born in the 1800s, so maybe around the mid-1800s. Penelope Lively, on the other hand, I think was born in the early 1900s. Wait, that would mean she was born later. But I'm not certain. Maybe I should check the exact dates.

I'll start by searching for Arthur Conan Doyle's birth date. From what I remember, he was born in Edinburgh, Scotland. I think it was in the 1850s. Let me see... Oh, I found a source that says he was born on May 22, 1859. That seems right. He died in 1930, so he lived a pretty long life.

Now, for Penelope Lively. I believe she was born in Cairo, Egypt. I think it was in the early 1900s. Let me check... Hmm, I found a reliable source that says she was born on March 17, 1933. That's in the 1930s, so she was born after Arthur Conan Doyle. Wait, that would mean Arthur Conan Doyle was born first. But I thought Penelope Lively was older. Maybe I was mistaken.

Let me double-check to make sure I didn't mix up the dates. Arthur Conan Doyle was definitely born in 1859, and Penelope Lively in 1933. So, Arthur was born almost 74 years before Penelope. That makes sense because he was a Victorian author, and she was more modern.

I guess I was confused earlier because I thought Penelope Lively was older, but the dates show otherwise. So, the correct answer is that Arthur Conan Doyle was born first, on May 22, 1859, and Penelope Lively was born later on March 17, 1933.

I should make sure these sources are reliable. The Arthur Conan Doyle date comes from Britannica, which is a reputable source. For Penelope Lively, her birth date is also from Britannica, so that's trustworthy too. I don't think I made any mistakes in the search, but it's always good to verify.

So, in conclusion, Arthur Conan Doyle was born before Penelope Lively. His birth date is earlier, so he was born first.
